sets.subject: 长难句
sets.title: 英语云端同步·长难句精拆组

items.text: Although access to information has expanded rapidly, the ability to distinguish reliable evidence from attractive but unsupported claims has not necessarily improved at the same pace.
items.reference: 尽管获取信息的渠道迅速扩展，但区分可靠证据与那些看似吸引人却缺乏支撑的说法的能力，并不一定以同样的速度提高。
items.analysis: Although引导让步状语；主干是the ability has not improved；to distinguish...修饰ability；unsupported修饰claims。

items.text: What appears to be a simple choice between two options may in fact depend on assumptions that neither side has made explicit.
items.reference: 表面上看似只是两个选项之间的简单选择，实际上可能取决于双方都没有明确说出的假设。
items.analysis: What从句作主语；主干may depend on assumptions；that引导定语从句修饰assumptions。

items.text: Researchers who focus only on average outcomes may overlook the fact that the same policy can affect different groups in sharply different ways.
items.reference: 只关注平均结果的研究者可能会忽视这样一个事实：同一项政策可能以截然不同的方式影响不同群体。
items.analysis: who引导定语从句修饰Researchers；that引导同位语从句解释the fact。

items.text: The more frequently a learner retrieves an idea from memory, the more likely that idea is to remain available when it is needed in a new context.
items.reference: 学习者越频繁地从记忆中提取一个观点，这个观点在新情境中需要使用时就越可能保持可调用状态。
items.analysis: the more..., the more...表示“越……越……”；when引导时间状语从句。

items.text: A system designed to reward visible activity can unintentionally discourage the quiet reflection on which high-quality decisions often depend.
items.reference: 一个旨在奖励可见活动的制度，可能会无意中抑制高质量决策常常依赖的安静反思。
items.analysis: designed...为过去分词短语修饰system；on which引导定语从句修饰reflection。
